title: Upgraded 2 Adds Four Returning Cast Members as Filming Continues in Italy
excerpt:
Aimee Carrero, Rachel Matthews, Andrew Schulz and Saoirse-Monica Jackson will reprise their roles.
Camila Mendes returns to lead and produce the romantic-comedy sequel.
body_md:
The romantic-comedy sequel Upgraded 2 has added four more returning performers from the original film. Aimee Carrero, Rachel Matthews, Andrew Schulz and Saoirse-Monica Jackson are all set to reprise their earlier roles, according to Deadline. The production is currently filming in Italy.

The four join previously announced returning stars Camila Mendes, Leslie Bibb and Marisa Tomei. Mendes also serves as a producer through Honor Role. Becca Gleason is directing the sequel, with Luke Roberts and Justin Matthews returning to write the screenplay. Amazon MGM Studios holds worldwide distribution rights.

The original Upgraded followed Ana, an ambitious art intern played by Mendes, who unexpectedly accompanied her demanding boss Claire, portrayed by Tomei, on a work trip to London. During the flight she met William, a wealthy and charming stranger played by Archie Renaux. The romantic comedy explored the challenges of balancing career ambitions, personal relationships and dreams, with much of its story unfolding between London and New York.

Plot details for the sequel remain under wraps. Although the production is taking place in Italy, that does not establish where the finished story is set or what the characters will experience. The confirmed development is the return of a substantial part of the first film's ensemble, rather than the disclosure of a new storyline.

Carrero's credits include Your Friends and Neighbors and The Menu. Matthews has worked on Frozen II, Happy Death Day and Do Revenge, and co-founded Honor Role with Mendes. Schulz is known for stand-up comedy and his acting work, including the upcoming live-action Street Fighter. Jackson is particularly familiar to audiences through Derry Girls, alongside appearances in The Decameron and other television projects.

Producers include Mike Karz and Bill Bindley of Gulfstream Pictures, Mendes and Matthews of Honor Role, Lena Roklin of Luber Roklin Entertainment and Piers Tempest of Tempo Production. No confirmed release date has been provided. For now, the returning cast and active production are the main verified developments, while the sequel's plot and eventual premiere remain undisclosed.
